title: Seeds in a map
hook: Explore the evidence behind a cosmic question.

knows: Light and gravity help astronomers study the universe.
doesNotKnow: Small differences in the early universe are related to the later growth of cosmic structure. Detailed CMB patterns help scientists test models of that evolution.

misconception: A learner may choose: They are photographs of present-day planets
objective: Use the visual model to reason about: Why are tiny variations in the cosmic microwave background scientifically useful?

claims.text: Question, correct answer and explanation: Why are tiny variations in the cosmic microwave background scientifically useful? They reveal small early-universe differences linked to later structure. Small differences in the early universe are related to the later growth of cosmic structure. Detailed CMB patterns help scientists test models of that evolution.
Visual caption: Small differences matter. The SVG is a conceptual illustration, not measured data or a scale model.
